title: Making the Ark, Table, Lampstand, and Incense Altar

questions.question: Who made the ark of the covenant?
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:1 (ESV): "Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood."

questions.question: What was the ark overlaid with?
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:2 (ESV): "He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside."

questions.question: What was on top of the ark?
options: A mercy seat with two cherubim of gold
questions.correctAnswer: A mercy seat with two cherubim of gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:6-7 (ESV): "He made a mercy seat of pure gold... And he made two cherubim of gold."

questions.question: What was also made from acacia wood overlaid with gold?
options: The table for the bread of the Presence
questions.correctAnswer: The table for the bread of the Presence
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:10-11 (ESV): "He also made the table of acacia wood... And he overlaid it with pure gold."

questions.question: How was the lampstand made?
options: Of hammered work of pure gold
questions.correctAnswer: Of hammered work of pure gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:17 (ESV): "He also made the lampstand of pure gold. He made the lampstand of hammered work."

questions.question: How many branches did the lampstand have?
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:18 (ESV): "Six branches going out of its sides, three branches out of one side and three out of the other."

questions.question: What decorations were on the lampstand branches?
options: Cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and flowers
questions.correctAnswer: Cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and flowers
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:19 (ESV): "Three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower."

questions.question: What utensils were made for the table?
options: Plates, dishes, bowls, and flagons of pure gold
questions.correctAnswer: Plates, dishes, bowls, and flagons of pure gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:16 (ESV): "He made the vessels of pure gold... its plates and dishes, its bowls and flagons."

questions.question: What was the altar of incense overlaid with?
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:26 (ESV): "He overlaid it with pure gold, its top and around its sides and its horns."

questions.question: What features were on the incense altar's corners?
options: Horns of one piece with it
questions.correctAnswer: Horns of one piece with it
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:25 (ESV): "And he made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it."

questions.question: How much gold was used for the entire lampstand and utensils?
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:24 (ESV): "He made it and all its utensils out of a talent of pure gold."

questions.question: What was the anointing oil called?
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:29 (ESV): "He made the holy anointing oil also, and the pure fragrant incense."

questions.question: What were the dimensions of the incense altar?
options: A cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high
questions.correctAnswer: A cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:25 (ESV): "A cubit long and a cubit wide. It was square, and two cubits was its height."

questions.question: Where were the cherubim's faces directed?
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:9 (ESV): "The cherubim had their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim."

questions.question: What held the poles for carrying the incense altar?
options: Two gold rings on opposite sides
questions.correctAnswer: Two gold rings on opposite sides
questions.explanation: Exodus 37:27 (ESV): "He made two rings of gold on it... as holders for the poles with which to carry it."

key_verse_text: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood.
